- **Guiding Presence:** Allies within **6"** of you gain **+1** on **SPI Checks**.
- **Wild Shape [0 AP]:** Once during each activation, transform into one **Novice Beast Form**. The form ends at the end of your next activation, when you are reduced to **0 HP**, or when you end it for **0 AP**. You cannot use **Wild Shape** after casting a **Tier 1** or higher **Druidic Ritual** during the same activation, while a form is active, or again during the same activation after a form ends.
  - **Form Rules:** Replace your **SPD** and **Sz** with the form's listed **SPD** and **Sz**, and use the form's listed flat **AV**. Because **Small** is derived from **Sz S**, you gain or lose **Small** as your Size changes. Your Chest armour and shield remain equipped, but their **AD**, **AV**, **DEX Pen**, **Max Speed**, Item Qualities, and other rules are suspended; you cannot use **Block** or **Parry**. Other modifiers still apply. Replace your weapon attacks with the form's natural attack. It counts as a weapon attack only for its normal AP cost and **Multiple Attacks**, and is not a weapon for other rules unless they explicitly affect natural attacks. Add the higher of **STR** or **SPI** to its damage; at Level 1 it rolls **1** base damage die. Items that occupy Hands remain equipped but cannot be used. Retain your HP, Wounds, NRG, ability scores, Talents, ancestry traits, known Powers, and class features. You cannot cast Powers or use scrolls. You may use **Dodge**, **Reflex Attack**, **Hide**, **Spot**, and **Interact** unless the form says otherwise.
  - **Wolf Shape:** Speed **7"**, **Sz M**, **AV 1**, **Bite:** 1d6 piercing damage. When you declare **Bite** against an enemy adjacent to at least 1 of your allies, the attack rolls 1 additional base damage die.
  - **Boar:** Speed **6"**, **Sz M**, **AV 2**, **Tusks:** 1d6 piercing damage. When you make a **Tusks** attack after using **Move** to move at least **3"** in a straight line toward the target during the same activation, the target is **Pushed 1"** directly away from you when this attack damages the target.
  - **Great Eagle:** Speed **5"**, **Fly (10")**, **Sz L**, **AV 1**, **Talons:** 1d4 slashing damage. While using **Fly**, you do not gain **Cover** from a terrain feature.
  - **Lynx:** Speed **7"**, **Sz S**, **AV 1**, **Claws:** 1d4 slashing damage. While in this form and in **Cover**, your **Hide distance** is **0"**. You ignore additional movement costs from **Difficult Terrain** and do not make terrain **Checks** caused by **Slippery Terrain**. **Small.**

patches.find:
##### Master Druid Talents

- **Great Shape:** Requires **Wild Shape**. While you are in **Wild Shape**, gain **+1 AV** and your **Wild Shape Form's** natural attack damage rolls one additional base damage die. If you have **Great Shape**, using **Wild Shape** costs **1 NRG**. When you select **Great Shape**, choose one **Apex Form** from the **Wild Shape Forms** table. That **Apex Form** is added to your available **Wild Shape Forms** for as long as you have **Great Shape**. You cannot select more than one **Apex Form**.
- **Wrath of the Wild:** Reduce the **NRG** cost of any **Tier 1** or higher **Druidic Ritual** that deals damage by **1**, to a minimum of **1 NRG**. Add **+3** to that Ritual's damage total.
- **Circle Renewal [1 AP, 3 NRG]:** During your activation, take this action immediately after you successfully cast a **Druidic Ritual**. All allied combatants within **6"** of you gain **Temporary HP** = 5 until the end of the round.

patches.find:
##### Master Assassin Talents

- **Death Mark:** Requires **Marked for Death**. The first weapon attack during each of your activations against your **Marked for Death** target while you are **Hidden** ignores **AV**. After applying **Advantage** and **Disadvantage**, treat one retained base damage die as having rolled its maximum value, triggering a **Critical Hit** and exploding bonus dice as normal.
- **Perfect Ambush:** While you are **Hidden**, your first weapon attack this activation deals an additional **4 damage of that attack's primary damage type** and ignores **Cover**.
- **Black Formula:** When you roll poison damage dice from a poison you applied or from a **Poisoned [dX]** condition you caused, each such die that shows its maximum value explodes: roll one additional die of the same type and add it to the total. If a die produced by that explosion also shows its maximum value, it explodes again. If a poison damage die from that source shows a **1**, you may reroll that die once and must use the new result; a rerolled die that shows its maximum value explodes normally. A die produced by an explosion cannot be rerolled by **Black Formula**. **Black Formula** does not make the attack a **Critical Hit**.

#### Ranger [3/5 Complexity]
